items.headline: Rip Current Statement issued October 18 at 11:50AM EDT until October 18 at 8:00PM EDT by NWS Wilmington NC
items.description:
* WHAT...Dangerous rip currents expected. There is also a strong
north to south longshore current expected.

* WHERE...Coastal New Hanover County.

* WHEN...From 6 AM EDT Sunday through Sunday evening.

* IMPACTS...Rip currents can sweep even the best swimmers away
from shore into deeper water.
items.instruction:
Swim near a lifeguard. If caught in a rip current, relax and
float. Don't swim against the current. If able, swim in a
direction following the shoreline. If unable to escape, face the
shore and call or wave for help.

items.headline: Gale Warning issued October 18 at 2:26AM EDT until October 19 at 8:00AM EDT by NWS Wilmington NC
items.description:
* WHAT...North winds 25 to 30 kt with gusts up to 40 kt and seas
7 to 10 ft.

* WHERE...Southeast North Carolina coastal waters out 20 NM.

* WHEN...Until 8 AM EDT Monday.

* IMPACTS...Strong winds will cause hazardous seas which could
capsize or damage vessels and reduce visibility.
items.instruction:
Mariners should alter plans to avoid these hazardous conditions.
Remain in port, seek safe harbor, alter course, and/or secure the
vessel for hazardous conditions.
